text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that she had a quiz coming up 
soon, I invited Agnes Tachyon to the 
library to help her study.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"My performance isn't so poor that I need 
you examining me, you know."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, in the sense of not participating in 
the tests, it's not uncommon for me to 
place dead last in the grade, however.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I make sure to take all the 
important tests. So there's no issue at 
all.
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure we handle the quiz 
properly too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's something I have no need for. While 
learning certainly enriches one's life—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I believe studying 
and acquiring knowledge should remain 
strictly within the realm of a hobby.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there's something I want to do 
more than taking the test."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... To tell the truth, I only 
finished brewing this potion this 
morning!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Drinking this activates your neural cells, 
allowing you to instantly perceive any 
phenomenon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After listening to an explanation of a 
medicine that sounded like pure danger... 
it turned out she had actually tried 
drinking it herself this morning.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—And so, if it succeeds, your nerves will 
be sharpened to ten times their normal 
state for at least half a day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, depending on the situation, 
fatigue-like symptoms might manifest, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Isn't it just! My mind is 
crystal clear right now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, unfortunately, that is all. It 
falls short of the initial tenfold plan.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, it took a whole lot of time 
and effort to make this, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I think I'm good on doing this 
experiment again for a while."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a heavy sigh and a muttered 'Good 
grief,' Agnes Tachyon left the library...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, she apparently did take the 
pop quiz. And earned a flawless, perfect 
score, it seems."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, depending on the situation, 
fatigue-like symptoms might manifest, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I do. Right now, I'm completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet at the same time, my mind feels 
strangely clear... It is quite a curious 
sensation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't call the experiment a complete 
success, but well, the results aren't half 
bad."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to her tone, Agnes 
Tachyon left the library looking 
completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, she apparently did take the 
pop quiz. And earned a flawless, perfect 
score, it seems."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so! My mind is crystal clear right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"This is purely a judgment based on 
sensation, but I can feel at least ten 
times the usual effect!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, having an experiment succeed is truly 
refreshing above all else! It was well 
worth the effort!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I must conduct tests and acquire data at 
once. Hehehe!
choice_data_list: What about studying for the quiz!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa now, did I ever say even once that 
I'd "study" today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Coming with you to the library was just 
part of a stroll to stimulate my brain, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And with that, I'll be taking my leave!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without giving anyone a chance to stop 
her, Agnes Tachyon walked out of the 
library with a light step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incidentally, I managed to get her to take 
the quiz, and the result was a flawless, 
perfect score.
